document_notes: The page contains the continuation of the entry for P. Aelius Severianus Maximus (PIR² A 260) at the top, followed by entries 261 to 270. Only the top entry (PIR² A 260) is relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus as it explicitly attests a legatus Augusti pro praetore.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as legatus Aug. pro praetore of Arabia in 193 and 194 AD.

segments.prosopographical_commentary: The author doubts the hypothesis of Stein and other scholars that Severianus was legatus of Thrace after his consulship, which was inferred from an inscription dedicated to his son in Perinthus.

entry_notes: The entry is split across pages; the beginning of the entry is on the preceding page, but the crucial governorship details for Arabia are fully preserved on this page.

problems.issue: The province 'Thracia' is not explicitly attested for P. Aelius Severianus Maximus as legatus Augusti pro praetore. The text states the governorship is doubted by the PIR author and is inferred by other scholars, not confirmed.
problems.suggested_fix: Set province_normalized to null for gov_2, as the evidence is low certainty and the PIR author explicitly doubts this governorship.

problems.issue: The end date for the inferred Thracia governorship is too broad (210). The text does not provide any date range beyond 'post consulatum (post a. 194)'.
problems.suggested_fix: Set date_normalized_end to null or a more conservative estimate (e.g., 200) if a range must be provided.
